title: Worksome Timesheet Registration
description: Payload format for submitting timesheet registrations to Worksome via the createCustomTimesheet GraphQL mutation using the 'default-json' schema. Accepts either a single object or an array of objects.

hireId.description: Worksome Global ID of the hire. Obtain from the Worksome GraphQL API.

reportedDate.description: Date of the registration in YYYY-MM-DD format.

hours.description: Number of hours worked on the reported date.

externalId.description: Unique identifier from the external system. Used as the key for updates — sending the same externalId replaces the existing registration for that date.

reference.description: Free-text reference field (e.g., project code, cost centre, purchase order number).

isPayable.description: Whether this registration is billable. Defaults to true.

meta.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata to store with the registration.
